# unicode-segmentation carried by pmndrs/glyph

This directory is the published `unicode-segmentation` 1.13.3 crate (Unicode 17) with its four
category lookups re-encoded. It is wired into `packages/glyph/rust/shaper` with
`[patch.crates-io]`, so the shaper manifest still asks for `unicode-segmentation = "=1.13.3"`.

## Base

- crate: `unicode-segmentation` 1.13.3 from crates.io, checksum
  `c6f5d3c3b1bf09027a88a6bc961fc00497d651009560b5463668dc81b0fa87a8`
- upstream commit: `66a032fd8d667bc47ac5b640b151dff3f5356d07` in
  <https://github.com/unicode-rs/unicode-segmentation>
- kept verbatim: `COPYRIGHT`, both licenses, `README.md`, and every file under `src/` except the
  changes below
- left out: `Cargo.toml.orig`, `.cargo_vcs_info.json`, `benches/`, `tests/` and the
  `criterion`, `proptest` and `quickcheck` dev-dependencies

## What the fork changes

Upstream stores the grapheme, word, sentence and emoji categories as sorted `(char, char, category)`
rows with a 128-code-point index, searched by binary search. Each row is 12 bytes of code points
that gzip barely compresses: about 23 kB of the shaper's gzip size for the four tables. The fork
answers the same lookups from one three-stage trie keyed by the combined
`(grapheme, word, sentence, emoji)` tuple (57 distinct tuples), about 4 kB gzip, in three loads.

| File                   | Change                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `src/category_trie.rs` | New, generated by `packages/glyph/scripts/generate-segmentation-trie.mjs` from `src/tables.rs` (checked by `unicode check-data`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `src/lib.rs`           | `mod category_trie;`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `src/tables.rs`        | `grapheme_category`, `word_category`, `sentence_category` and `emoji_category` read the trie and return the one-code-point range `(c, c, category)`; callers use the range only to skip a repeated lookup. The range tables, their indexes and the binary searches compile only for tests, as the `*_category_by_range` oracle; a test compares both for every scalar value. Three unused imports are allowed. |
| `src/word.rs`          | The upstream property-test module needs `proptest` and is compiled out.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `Cargo.toml`           | Benches, test targets and dev-dependencies removed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

The segmentation algorithms are untouched; the shaper's UAX #29 conformance tests
(`tests/unicode_*_conformance.rs`) run against this crate.

## Updating the base

Replace `src/` (keeping `category_trie.rs` out), the licenses, `README.md` and `Cargo.toml` with the
new release, reapply the changes above, run `pnpm --filter @pmndrs/glyph run unicode generate-data`,
and run `cargo test --manifest-path vendor/unicode-segmentation/Cargo.toml` and the shaper tests.
